answer: Anyone running 148 aliases hence needs 176 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in nebula, expire in knoll, and relic lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 781 identities would post 2969 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
